name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub mirrors the consumed contract surface of the llm message seam (merge-extensible MessageSourceMap, Message/UserMessage shapes, frozen message creators) and implements just enough behavior for real-composition tests. Mirrors dsh-private commit 9451be2 (2026-08-07 snapshot).
